source_captures.content: Fixture source text for ResearchBrain Stage-0 runtime plumbing. It describes falsifiable mechanism framing only and contains no profitability evidence.
claims_extracted: Mechanism-first hypotheses should be falsifiable before any deterministic WFA is launched.
limitations: Fixture source; not live web, paper, terminal, or broker evidence.
disconfirming_relevance: A mechanism can be plausible yet fail after spread, swap, session, and OOS controls.

hypothesis_packets.mechanism: Volatility compression followed by directional liquidity-taking pressure may define a falsifiable continuation mechanism.
hypothesis_packets.falsifiable_prediction: If the mechanism is real, later deterministic WFA should show OOS consistency after realistic costs; this fixture makes no such claim.
hypothesis_packets.market_structure_assumption: The idea is constrained to broker-supported FTMO MT5 symbols from the Phase 8A universe.
hypothesis_packets.instrument_scope: Any Phase 8A FTMO MT5 symbol class may be considered later; not crypto-only and no prediction markets.
hypothesis_packets.timeframe_candidate: M15-H1 candidate only, to be selected later by deterministic planning.
hypothesis_packets.required_data: MT5 terminal OHLCV plus spread/swap/spec evidence before any MT5-bound claim.
hypothesis_packets.expected_holding_period: Intraday to multi-session; fixture estimate only before WFA.
hypothesis_packets.expected_trade_frequency: Unknown until deterministic planning and data checks; no profitability label assigned.
expected_failure_modes: Spread and swap costs overwhelm any apparent continuation.
Effect is isolated to a post-hoc subset and fails across assets.
invalidation_criteria: No source-backed deterministic pre-registration exists later.
No OOS consistency after later WFA and cost controls.
hypothesis_packets.implementation_shape: Rule-based signal generator candidate shape for later planning only; no code or WFA is executed here.
hypothesis_packets.execution_sensitivity: Sensitive to spread, swap, session boundaries, contract specs, and bar construction.
hypothesis_packets.mt5_ftmo_concerns: Requires terminal-backed symbol specs and later FTMO rule accounting before any promotion path.
prior_related_lessons: For live tool mode, capture_url_source must include source_id, url, and source_class; the URL must be one returned by search_web in the same run.
record_hypothesis must cite captured source id SRC-LIVE-CANARY-001 and must include source_claims only as Stage-0 source-backed mechanism claims, not MT5 verification or profitability claims.
Use timeframe_candidate 'M15-H1 candidate' and include at least one prior_failed_patterns_checked item such as 'No blocking failed-pattern match returned by check_failed_pattern_similarity'.
In invalidation_criteria, avoid Sharpe, returns, win-rate, profit-factor, positive expectancy, or any metric that sounds like a profitability or promotion claim.
prior_failed_patterns_checked: Historical simple indicator variants are treated as stale overfit-prone patterns.
hypothesis_packets.novelty_reason: Fixture exercises source-backed Stage-0 packet wiring under Phase 8A universe constraints.
disconfirming_evidence: Fixture provenance means no real external evidence has been collected.
hypothesis_packets.proposed_experiment_shape: Stage-0 discovery artifact only; any later experiment must be separately planned and deterministic.
